content.short: BracketX makes decentralized options strategies easy with leverage through range-bound derivatives.
content.description: BracketX provides decentralized, leverage-enabled options strategies built around range-bound derivatives. Its Passage product offers a long/short volatility market for BTC, ETH, and other altcoins, designed for traders who don't have a strong directional view and who want a complement to perpetual contracts. Fully audited and on-chain, BracketX makes volatility trading approachable, easy to understand, simple to purchase, and straightforward to monitor for hedging or speculative use cases.
